pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by HandTevy.
Pediatric hypotension is defined as SBP < 70 + (age in years x 2) mmHg

pl1: Assess for a Stroke and follow Stroke COG accordingly
Oral rehydration if stroke assessment negative and patient can manage their own airway
4 lead and 12 lead placement / acquisition of ECG
Isotonic Crystalloid as needed for dehydration or hypotension not caused by hemorrhage
